models.name: Mistral Large 3
models.variant: sparse MoE, 41B active / 675B total parameters; instruct release (reasoning version announced as coming soon)
models.capability_summary: Mistral 将 Large 3 定位为其迄今最强模型，也是 Mixtral 系列之后首个稀疏 MoE（41B 激活/675B 总参，Apache 2.0 开源，旗舰多模态多语言定位）。已收录评测为榜单类定位：LMArena 开源非推理类第 2、开源总榜第 6。

models.name: Ministral 3 14B

notes: Page fetched via web-reader; page metadata carries no timestamp - release date taken from the official mistral.ai RSS feed (pubDate Tue, 02 Dec 2025 16:00:00 GMT). Only two scores exist in prose; all other evaluation content is chart images (base-models chart, instruct comparison chart, GPQA Diamond accuracy chart, LMArena chart) and was not machine-read, so Ministral GPQA and comparison-model columns produced no evidence rows. 'Ministral instruct models match or exceed the performance of comparable models' and 'parity with the best instruction-tuned open-weight models' are relative claims without printed numbers. Ministral model doc names use the -25-12 suffix, consistent with a December 2025 release. Companion research paper for the Ministral 3 architecture is linked from the page but not harvested here. 2026-09-01 audit: the four chart images were visually inspected on the live page - they are scatter/bar charts with NO printed value labels (GPQA Diamond Accuracy chart plots accuracy vs output tokens for Ministral3 14B/8B/3B Instruct vs Gemma3/Qwen3-VL), so values can only be estimated from axis positions; the no-rows decision is confirmed as correct rather than an omission. Both prose scores re-verified verbatim: "85% on AIME 25 with our 14B variant" and "debuts at #2 in the OSS non-reasoning models category (#6 amongst OSS models overall) on the LMArena leaderboard".
